title: fix: correct opencode-pollinations-plugin package name in README
author: kreggscode
pr_body_excerpt: Fixes the package name from open-code-pollinations-plugin to opencode-pollinations-plugin to match the actual npm package name.

gist.headline: One hyphen found its hive
gist.blurb: The install command now points to the package that actually exists. Fewer mysterious npm scavenger hunts for everyone.
gist.summary: Corrected the README package name from `open-code-pollinations-plugin` to the published `opencode-pollinations-plugin` npm package.
gist.impact: Developers can now copy the README install command and reach the correct OpenCode Pollinations plugin package.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny librarian or terminal mechanic carefully moving a misplaced pixel hyphen into the correct npm package label on a cozy CRT terminal, with a small code-plant and flowers nearby.
